The '''Eesin''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Their hives were known to be busy with much activity, to the point that an active [[Hangar/Legends|landing bay]] could resemble one.<ref name="CrossC" />
